entries.snippet: Meta has unveiled audio-only smart glasses, with some questioning whether it is a response to the backlash over privacy.

entries.snippet: Campaigners hope the new words will lead to less body shaming and more sex positivity.

entries.snippet: A judge has ordered that the Trump administration restore journalists' access to White House. And, Tucker Carlson sits down with Morning Edition 's Steve Inskeep for a Newsmakers interview.

entries.title: Needy couples got cash and a spending plan. Results were good -- and bad
entries.snippet: In Liberia, joint financial planning boosted cash aid's benefits. It also had an unexpected consequence for some families.

entries.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
entries.snippet: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.

entries.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
entries.snippet: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

entries.title: States threaten action against company earning millions off disabled vets
entries.snippet: The investigations by attorneys general follow a recent bankruptcy filing in the face of civil lawsuits, falling revenues, and impending debt payments.

entries.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
entries.snippet: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

entries.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump
entries.snippet: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.

entries.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House
entries.snippet: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

entries.title: Venezuela's acting leader promises elections at the 'right moment'
entries.snippet: Venezuela's acting president, delivering her first address to the U.N. General Assembly since coming to power, promised elections and said the nation's people will determine the "right moment."

entries.title: OpenAI's breach of Australian health department website prompts rebuke
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said he was extremely concerned about OpenAI 's breach of an Australian health department website that the artificial intelligence company took too long to reveal.

entries.title: What's making it harder for American family farms to survive

entries.snippet: Marlon James' new novel, "The Disappearers," was shortlisted for the Booker Prize. It tells the story of a group of gay men trying to make their way, and stay alive, in the homophobic culture of Jamaica in the 1980s and 90s. It's raw, violent and sexually explicit, while also lea

entries.title: Maine Dems hammer Collins over report of pay-to-play probe. GOP senator calls it 'completely false'
entries.snippet: Maine Democrats on Wednesday assailed U.S. Sen. Susan Collins over a news report that the FBI investigated how much she knew about illegal campaign contributions that sent one of her donors to prison.

entries.title: 3 things to know about rising diesel prices and how they affect you
entries.snippet: Diesel prices have reached historic highs as a result of the U.S. war in Iran and Russia's war in Ukraine, and consumers will bear the brunt of the rising cost, experts say.

entries.title: FBI investigates hackers' claim to have stolen employee data, compromised jobs website
entries.snippet: The FBI said Wednesday it was investigating a criminal hacking group's claims that it had stolen "very sensitive data" belonging to thousands of agents and applicants and that it had compromised the bureau's jobs website.

entries.title: AI firm leaders tell UN Security Council that it could be a risk to all humanity
entries.snippet: The heads of major artificial intelligence firms pleaded with the United Nations on Wednesday to set controls over the burgeoning technology they are designing in order to save the world — or, at least, its people.

entries.title: Judge questions Trump's ban of three prominent news outlets from White House
entries.snippet: A federal judge weighing whether to block President Donald Trump's ban of three news outlets from White House grounds expressed some skepticism Wednesday in response to the government's defense of the move.

entries.title: Trump's focus on noncitizen voting has led to 160 arrests. That shows it's rare, experts say
entries.snippet: The Trump administration's whole-of-government effort to find and prosecute noncitizens illegally on state voter rolls has resulted in about 1,600 voter fraud cases that have led to 160 arrests, Homeland Security Investigations senior official Matthew Millhollin said in a press b

entries.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders unveils bill to ban artificial superintelligence and create Department of AI
entries.snippet: Two leading progressive lawmakers, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar, are unveiling legislation Wednesday that would ban artificial superintelligence and create a federal agency to oversee advanced AI.

entries.title: Mississippi police make 2nd arrest in death of Tasia Fortune, seek 3rd suspect
entries.snippet: Police in Mississippi have arrested a second man in the death of a Black woman found hanging from a tree and have issued an arrest warrant for a third suspect.

entries.title: Senior NATO commander warns Putin is becoming more cavalier and open to risk as Ukraine war drags on
entries.snippet: Air Chief Marshal Sir John Stringer spoke to The Associated Press at a security conference in Estonia amid warnings from some European leaders that Moscow is planning to test NATO's collective defense pact with bolder attacks that have already included sabotage and espionage.

entries.title: Polo off Mexican coast is among 'the strongest storms ever'
entries.snippet: The U.S. National Hurricane Center in Miami has called Polo an "extremely dangerous" storm and forecast the system would turn sharply to the northwest before moving west-northwest over the next several days.

entries.title: Harvey Weinstein is sentenced to 15 years in prison for 2006 sex crime in New York
entries.snippet: Weinstein was sentenced Wednesday to 15 years in prison for sexually assaulting a TV production assistant in 2006, capping a yearslong legal odyssey that a judge said cemented the disgraced movie mogul's reputation as "the literal face of the #MeToo movement."

entries.title: China's Xi kicks off state visit to Washington with a rare planeside welcome from Trump
entries.snippet: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on Wednesday, where he was met with a rare planeside greeting from President Donald Trump after their top officials agreed to extend a trade truce until January.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: 'Pope fever' takes hold as Pope Leo visits France
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV is expected to draw large crowds during his visit to France. As part of his trip to Europe, he's also set to address the continent's future and some of the challenges ahead.

entries.title: UNGA: Netanyahu, Abbas to speak as Middle East dominates day
entries.snippet: Israel's Netanyahu can expect to be greeted by protests, while the Palestinian Abbas will address the body via video after the US denied him a visa. Beyond the Middle East, rising sea levels will be on the day 3 agenda.

entries.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
entries.snippet: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.

entries.title: Tensions between India and Bangladesh are in focus after Dhaka skipped the BRICS summit in Delhi
entries.snippet: Bangladesh's absence from the BRICS summit in New Delhi has raised fresh questions about strained ties. Ousted PM Sheikh Hasina's exile in India remains a major obstacle to normalizing relations.

entries.title: India news: Cockroach party demands Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
entries.snippet: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke has alleged that the removal of more than 130 million names from draft electoral rolls is designed to benefit the BJP and weaken opposition parties. DW has more.

entries.title: Poland says Starlink station fire 'act of sabotage'
entries.snippet: Polish Deputy Prime Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said Warsaw believed the attack aimed to disrupt internet access for the Ukrainian military, calling it "an element of the next phase of hybrid warfare."

entries.title: Morocco: Center-right PAM leads in parliamentary election
entries.snippet: PAM is part of Morocco's outgoing ruling coalition and was founded by an adviser to the king. The moderate Islamist Justice and Development Party surged amid increasing voter apathy.

entries.title: Germany news: Bundestag to discuss opt-out organ donation
entries.snippet: Parliamentarians debate whether to change Germany's organ donation scheme amid a lack of supply. They will also consider reforms to expand the power of intelligence agencies. DW has more.

entries.title: Germany: Economic institutes double growth forecast for 2026
entries.snippet: Experts predict German GDP will double to 1.3% this year but warn of structural difficulties ahead. The picture is complicated, they say, especially because of uncertainty in the energy sector.

entries.title: US judge blocks Trump ban of CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House, orders him to restore access
entries.snippet: A judge has ordered President Trump to restore White House access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico after he banned the media outlets from the premises.

entries.title: OpenAI agent hacked Australia government portal: PM Albanese
entries.snippet: The hack of Australian health data marks the world's first known AI-led breach of a government website.

entries.title: Germany sets out plan to phase out fossil fuels by 2045
entries.snippet: Germany sets out a plan to phase out coal, oil and gas by 2045, reaffirming a climate strategy focused on electrification.

entries.title: Trump welcomes China's Xi for high-stakes summit
entries.snippet: Donald Trump welcomed Xi Jinping to the US by greeting him personally on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews. The two are expected to discuss trade, AI, Taiwan and Iran during a three-day state visit.

entries.title: Berlin Airport briefly suspends flights over drone sighting
entries.snippet: Airspace over the German capital was closed for about 45 minutes after a drone was spotted on the runway. Flights have resumed but are experiencing delays.

entries.title: Harvey Weinstein resentenced to 15 years for sexual assault
entries.snippet: The disgraced Hollywood mogul was found guilty of sexually assaulting former production assistant Miriam Haley. The man whose case spurred the #MeToo movement awaits a separate sentencing in a California rape case.

entries.title: New fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region raises fears of a return to the country's civil war
entries.snippet: Fighting in and around Tigray is testing Ethiopia's fragile 2022 peace deal. With old enemies forming new alliances, experts warn that the conflict could enter a dangerous new phase.

entries.title: Eviction of 87-year-old woman sparks housing protests in Madrid
entries.snippet: Police escorted Maricarmen Abascal from the apartment she had called home for more than seven decades. The case has reignited debate over Spain's housing crisis, rising rents and protections for long-term tenants.

entries.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45B for reconstruction in Gaza
entries.snippet: The board has noted that the Palestinian enclave needs roughly $35.2 billion for full, medium-term reconstruction. Trump's plan for peace in Gaza has largely stalled since an agreement was reached almost a year ago.

entries.title: Who is skipping the UN General Assembly — and why
entries.snippet: Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, Friedrich Merz, Giorgia Meloni and Mahmoud Abbas are among more than 50 leaders who won't make it to the UN General Assembly. Their reasons range from illness and domestic affairs to holidays.
